searchText: I revamped the intro section of the spec to be more ~~like wasm~~ structured: https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs/pull/33 I'll keep working on it today but I think this part is mergeable already (with a couple of TBD inside) due to us being distributed across timezones, I'll wait for feedback until tomorrow 14:00 CEST and if no one complains I'll merge it 🙂 > Beam Sync nodes *eventually* end up with the full state though, right? <@!301186049323958275> Not necessarily, a minimal implementation would only request nodes that are required for block execution. Long forgotten parts of the state trie would never be downloaded in that case. In practice client teams seem motivated to only ship it if it can also "backfill" the state. This is a separate thread that is attempting to get the full state like the state download step in fast sync.

excerpts.content:
> Beam Sync nodes *eventually* end up with the full state though, right?
<@!301186049323958275> Not necessarily, a minimal implementation would only request nodes that are required for block execution. Long forgotten parts of the state trie would never be downloaded in that case. In practice client teams seem motivated to only ship it if it can also "backfill" the state. This is a separate thread that is attempting to get the full state like the state download step in fast sync.
